city.title: City
city.description: City name as it appears on the map, e.g. Phoenix, Manchester, Berlin. Matched against the city's administrative boundary.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: One or more business categories to search.

requirePhone.title: Only businesses with a phone number
requirePhone.description: Return only businesses that list a phone number (best for call/SMS outreach). Turn off to also get businesses with just a website or address.

maxPerCategory.title: Max results per category
maxPerCategory.description: Cap on results per category for one city.

overpassUrl.title: Overpass endpoint (advanced)
overpassUrl.description: Alternative Overpass API endpoint, e.g. a private instance. Leave empty for the public one.
